common_prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE full desktop app screenshot for Trace, a high fidelity STATIC interaction concept, landscape 16:9. Not a poster, device mockup, storyboard, or collage. This is one state in a nine-state sequence of the SAME editable living document about 收藏后为什么接不回来. The reference images establish the visual identity only; evolve their UX as instructed, do not copy their ambiguous chat composer.
Visual language: luminous ivory paper, subtle pale celadon ink-wash tributaries and translucent hills ONLY around the perimeter, deep pine green typography and controls, extremely restrained amber for attention. Large quiet almost-opaque editable ivory sheet, subtly irregular layered-paper edge, not a grid of cards. Honest crisp legible Simplified Chinese, refined Chinese serif headline, comfortable dark sans serif body; ample whitespace; functional small controls. Exactly ONE tiny ink-brush bird perched at the active focus, unobtrusive. No fixed sidebar, no rail, no dashboard, no progress percentages, no dense graph, no chat avatars or full transcript, no water effects behind text. No second bottom general-purpose message composer. Main text itself is editable. Source/context nodes small and collapsed until needed.
Stable shell: top-left deep-green Trace mark and Trace wordmark; subtle breadcrumb 在意的事 / 收藏后为什么接不回来. Top-right 看看来路 and 收起; discreet personal avatar bottom-left. Page title 收藏后为什么接不回来. Sheet header 我的理解 with a precise state label. All content is a designed illustrative scenario, not real product integration claims. Tiny unobtrusive footer 交互概念 · 示例内容. State identity is expressed through actual UI content, not a giant numbered explanation or overlay.
prompt_reconstruction: 每张实际提示词 = common_prompt + 两个换行 + state_prompt
